title: Cinematic Black and White Portrait
shortDescription: A dramatic monochrome portrait with hard side light, deep shadows, and fine film grain against a textured wall.
promptText:
Cinematic black and white portrait of a woman with short dark hair, standing in front of a textured plaster wall.
Dramatic hard side lighting from the left, deep sculpted shadows, and a soft highlight on the cheekbone.
Shot on an 85mm lens at f/1.8 with shallow depth of field, fine analog film grain, high contrast, rich tonal range.
Quiet, introspective expression, eyes looking slightly away from the camera.
Vertical 3:4 composition, photorealistic, no text, no watermark.
